trip.name: London, Oct 9–12 2026
trip.planningRules: Fixed plans come first. Suggest things near where they are or on the way to the next fixed plan; don't send them across London and back.
trip.about: Home base: Airbnb in Marylebone, near Marble Arch. Getting around: Tube, Elizabeth line, buses, walking; Uber/black cab late at night.
trip.group: 5 guys, ~25, from California. Into fashion (especially streetwear), music, food, movies and sports. Fixed plans come first, efficient transport second, sightseeing and shopping fill the gaps.

home.name: Airbnb (Marylebone)
home.notes: Nearest stations: Marble Arch (Central line, 3 min walk) and Bond Street (Elizabeth, Central, Jubilee, 10 min walk). Elizabeth line from Bond Street goes direct to Heathrow.

2026-10-09.label: Fri 9 Oct: travel day + West Ham
2026-10-09.flow: Fly in from Belfast → Elizabeth line to Bond Street → drop bags → Selfridges / Soho for a couple of hours → Central line from Marble Arch to Stratford → match → smart exit home.

2026-10-10.label: Sat 10 Oct: Soho streetwear → Chelsea match → Kutir
2026-10-10.flow: Soho/Carnaby streetwear when shops open (~11:00): Supreme, Palace, Stüssy, ALD, END., Footpatrol, record shops on Berwick St, Kith on Regent St. Grab lunch by 13:00, then District/Piccadilly line west to Stamford Bridge by 14:20 for Chelsea vs Bournemouth (15:00). After the match walk the King's Road (Saatchi Gallery) to Kutir for 19:15.

2026-10-11.label: Sun 11 Oct: East London → Borough → South Bank → OMA
2026-10-11.flow: Brick Lane / Shoreditch in the morning (Sunday markets, Beigel Bake, Rough Trade East, Goodhood) → Borough Market before it closes at 16:00 → Tower Bridge / South Bank / Tate Modern / BFI → OMA 21:00. NFL games on Sunday evening if you want a sports bar.

2026-10-12.label: Mon 12 Oct: checkout → Heathrow T3
2026-10-12.flow: Pack, quick breakfast near the Airbnb, Selfridges if there's time (opens 10:00), checkout, Elizabeth line from Bond Street to Heathrow Terminals 2 & 3. Be at T3 by 11:30.

plans.title: BA1395 Belfast (BHD) → Heathrow (LHR)

details.arrives: Heathrow 13:25 (BA domestic arrivals normally use Terminal 5; check the BA app)

plans.tips: Leave-by for this one uses a rough distance estimate (TfL only covers London). Belfast City airport is ~10–15 min by taxi from the city centre.

facts.topic: Landed at Heathrow: how to get to the Airbnb
facts.best: Elizabeth line from Heathrow (Terminal 5 or Terminals 2&3 station) direct to Bond Street, ~35–40 min, about £13–14 each with contactless/Apple Pay. Tap the same card/phone in and out. Bond Street → Airbnb is a 10 min walk (or Marble Arch on the Central line is 3 min from the door).
facts.alternative: Black cab/Uber for 5 with bags is ~60–75 min in traffic and roughly £70–110 total (you'd need an XL/2 cars). Only worth it if bags are huge.
facts.avoid: Heathrow Express goes to Paddington, which is the wrong side of Hyde Park for you.

plans.title: West Ham United vs QPR

location.name: London Stadium
location.address: Queen Elizabeth Olympic Park, London E20 2ST

plans.tips: From the Airbnb: Central line from Marble Arch goes direct to Stratford (~25 min), or the Elizabeth line from Bond Street (~17 min). From Stratford station it's a 15–20 min walk through Westfield to the stadium. Bags bigger than A4 aren't allowed. Wear layers: it gets cold up in the Upper tier at night.

facts.situation: Stratford station gets rammed after the final whistle (~21:55). Police hold queues on the walk back; 30–45 min waits are normal.
facts.option1: Leave on 85–88 min if the game's decided and walk straight to Stratford: Central line direct to Marble Arch (~25 min) or Elizabeth line direct to Bond Street (~17 min). Friday = Night Tube on the Central line, so no rush on time.
facts.option2: Hang back 30–40 min: grab food or a drink in Westfield Stratford City and let the crowd clear, then take the Central/Elizabeth line home.
facts.option3: Walk 15–20 min to Hackney Wick (Overground) to dodge the Stratford crush. Handy if you're heading to East London after.
facts.avoid: Pudding Mill Lane DLR is usually exit-only / closed after matches.

plans.title: Chelsea vs Bournemouth

details.kickoff: 15:00 (Premier League; kick-off times can move for TV, so check the Chelsea app)

plans.tips: Fulham Broadway (District line) is the nearest station but gets jammed; West Brompton (District/Overground) is a calmer 10 min walk. Stamford Bridge to Kutir is only ~25 min on foot or bus 14/414 towards Chelsea, so walk the King's Road to dinner after the match.

facts.topic: After the Chelsea match: straight to Kutir
facts.situation: Final whistle ~16:55. Fulham Broadway station queues build fast.
facts.option1: Skip the Tube: walk ~25 min along Fulham Road / King's Road to Chelsea, with time for a drink near Sloane Square before Kutir at 19:15.
facts.option2: Bus 14 or 414 from Fulham Road towards South Kensington/Chelsea if legs are tired.
facts.avoid: Fulham Broadway straight after the whistle, unless you're going back to the Airbnb first.

plans.title: Dinner at Kutir

details.name: Group reservation
details.style: Modern Indian from Rohit Ghai (ex-Gymkhana/Jamavar). Smart casual.

plans.tips: Sloane Square (District/Circle) is a 5 min walk. From Soho: Piccadilly line to South Kensington, or bus 19/22 down to the King's Road. If running late, call the restaurant.

plans.title: Dinner at OMA

location.name: OMA
location.address: 3 Bedale Street, London SE1 9AL (upstairs from Agora, Borough Market)

details.style: Greek-inspired, crudo bar + live-fire kitchen by David Carter (Smokestak, Manteca). Sunday kitchen hours listed as 12:00–22:00, so be on time.

plans.tips: London Bridge station (Jubilee/Northern) is 3 min away. Getting home: Jubilee line London Bridge → Bond Street (~12 min). Sunday night: no Night Tube, last Jubilee trains are around 23:30–00:00, so Uber/black cab if you stay out (~£20–30).

facts.checkout: Assumed checkout 10:00 (edit itinerary.json if your Airbnb says otherwise). Do a sweep: chargers, passports, anything in the fridge.
facts.airport: Elizabeth line from Bond Street (10 min walk) direct to Heathrow Terminals 2&3 (~30 min). Plan to leave around 10:30–10:45 to be at T3 by 11:30.
facts.breakfast: Quick options within 10 min walk: Selfridges Foodhall (opens 10:00), Paul Rothe & Son on Marylebone Lane (old-school deli, opens early on weekdays).

plans.title: VS141 Heathrow (LHR) → Los Angeles (LAX)

details.terminal: Terminal 3 (Virgin's Heathrow terminal; confirm in the Virgin app)

plans.tips: Elizabeth line from Bond Street to 'Heathrow Terminals 2 & 3' (not the Terminal 5 branch), ~30 min. Contactless/Apple Pay. Last chance for London shopping is T3 airside.
